# 人工智慧視覺技術學分學程

## 元智大學人工智慧視覺技術學分學程科目規劃表
Yuan Ze University Artificial Intelligence for Computer Vision and Imaging Technology Program Course Planning Table
115 / 4 / 29 一一四學年度第七次教務會議通過
Passed by the 7th Academic Affairs Meeting, Academic Year 2025, on April 29, 2026

### 一、教學目標 Teaching Objectives
為配合協助政府的產業創新計畫，驅動產業發展量能，為因應這波人工智慧革命，本學分學程屬於人工智慧技術學分學程，主要設計給電機資訊領域的學生，透過循序漸進的修課規劃，讓學生除了有完備的人工智慧技術外，也了解相關倫理議題，才能在影像、視覺或相關應用有上基於人本的創新。
This program is designed primarily for students in electrical engineering and computer science fields in order to support national industrial innovation initiatives and boost development capacity in response to the ongoing AI revolution. The curriculum is structured to progressively build students' technical expertise in AI while also ensuring they understand the ethical implications of AI technologies. This foundation prepares students to pursue human - centered innovations in areas such as computer vision, image analysis, and related applications.

### 二、課程設計 Curriculum Design

### 三、學程證書授予標準 Certificate Award Criteria
有意修讀本學分學程之同學，請自行至個人 Portal 完成線上選課作業。Students intending to apply for this credit program shall submit an online application through their personal Portal accounts.
凡修畢本學分學程規定課程並累計修滿 15 學分者，請向 AI 中心提出申請；經審核通過後，授予「人工智慧視覺技術學分學程」證書。Students who have accumulated 15 credits in this credit program may submit an application to the AI Center. Upon review and approval, a certificate for the Artificial Intelligence for Computer Vision and Imaging Technology Program will be awarded.
凡修畢 AI 聯盟開設課程的 3 門及其他院系開設課程 2 門者，累計達 5 門課程者，得申請教育部頒發的證書；欲申請者請向 AI 中心提出申請，經審核通過後將授予證書。Students who have completed three courses offered by TAICA and two courses offered by other departments, for a total of five courses, may apply for a certificate issued by the Ministry of Education. Applicants shall submit their application to the AI Center; upon review and approval, the certificate will be awarded.

### 四、領域別 Fields of Study
人工智慧 Artificial Intelligence
